studies.title: The dromedary
studies.caption: One hump and broad padded feet distinguish the dromedary. Its ability to carry loads through dry country supported caravan routes across Arabia and the Sahara.
studies.prompt: Full-body single Camelus dromedarius walking across gravel desert in Arabia, exactly one hump, long curved neck, tan coat, broad two-toed padded feet, four natural legs. Sparse thorn shrubs, no saddle or rider, no Bactrian second hump, no pyramids.
